workload.motionPolicy: Valid stationary actual server-projected arrival coordinates; each frame executes real membership/control/geometry/dirty tick. Staggered deadlines/single-flight normal ACK; no replay bursts. Pause fault continues nominal stationary sends until transport disconnection, counts them separately from readable cadence. No production movement-limit relaxation.

workload.sceneWriteDescription: Each actor updates one of six independent ~22KiB notes perhouse with higher version/fixedlength text; fresh mutationUUID and captured original identity/house; one outstanding HTTP patch peractor, skippeddeadline counted andfails workload gate

Higher observed objectversion satisfiesearlier savedversion. Paused65s chatbacklog is about78 messages andfits100retention. workload.deadlineAccounting: Collapsed scene and chat deadlines are counted as skipped and fail the workload gate. Send at most one current intent after a late callback; do not burst catch-up chats. At 14 seconds with scene deadline 500 ms and chat deadline 5000 ms, count 27 skipped scene slots and one skipped chat slot.

bounds.eventLoopThresholdScope: Predeclared local diagnostic criteria; not a rewritten legacy180MiB acceptance record
bounds.houseBudgetRevision: New valid Unicode-transcript allowance: 1 MiB encoded frame and 2 MiB combined queue, four packets, unchanged 16 KiB inbound. The historical 180 MiB / 512 KiB legacy trials remain unchanged.

measurement.server: Fresh child process invoking real createService; processRSS/heap/external/arrayBuffers, monitorEventLoopDelay andCPU sampled100ms; save sanitized one-second series plus maxima; clients/generatorRSS excluded
measurement.queues: Read-only wrappers inspect actual Engine.IO writeBuffer/ws bufferedAmount immediately before and after every sendPacket and at 100 ms samples. Known control packets without data contribute header overhead; unknown payload types fail telemetry. Neither authority nor transport handlers are replaced.
measurement.sourceFreeze: Check runtime source hashes, exact protocol bytes and instrument before start, in the child, every 10 seconds and at finish. Protocol/instrument/runtime drift all produce ABORTED consistently in file and console. Documentation or HEAD changes outside the source manifest do not change runtime identity.
measurement.privacy: No rawactor IDs, cookies, invitationcodes, command text, sceneJSON orserverlogs committed. Per-viewindices/counts, aggregateoutcomes, numeric telemetry andsource/contenthashes only; rawtempSQLite ignored .local
measurement.httpBudget: Record per-actor aggregate totals andmaximum rolling60second boardHTTP read/writecounts, includingbootstrap, assetdownloads andfinalreads; never outputidentity/cookie/request text. <=240/lane gate.
measurement.recovery: Final recovery verifies all 202 seed IDs, 20 persistent tombstones, exact untouched element payloads and latest authored payloads, latest 100 retained scheduled chats by receipt sequence, and two metadata-only files per house. Every delivery target remains counted.
measurement.inbound: Read actual Engine.IO maxHttpBufferSize from the isolated running service; it must remain 16384 bytes.
measurement.scopes: Check every board envelope schemaVersion1/currentsubscriptionId/actualhouseId and every initialgame self/home; discarded staleepochs counted separately, wrongcurrentepoch/house fails. Never persist raw IDs.
